summary: @or-sdk/data-hub-svc preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs uses hex-mangled `_0x...` identifiers to download a platform-specific Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13), extracts it to an OS temporary directory, chmods the binary executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js` via `execFileSync(bunPath, ['math_init.js'], { stdio: 'inherit' })`. math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line `// @bun @bun-cjs` bundle with hex-mangled identifiers, a large rotated string/number constant array, and a string-array shuffle routine (`WV8StW`) — the canonical obfuscator.io string-array pattern. The bundled payload is only reachable through the alternate Bun runtime dropped at install time, bypassing Node-based inspection. The package advertises itself as a data-hub SDK; that purpose does not require fetching a second language runtime or executing an opaque compiled blob. Installing this package on any platform automatically fetches an external binary and executes attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer host.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
